alternatives: Requiring the manager's explicit 'Approved for closure' before the closure commit
Relaying the review verdict to the manager and holding the task in tasks/qa/ until an answer arrives
extracted_decision.rationale: With the manager out of session, the closure gate is delegated to the reviewer verdict recorded in the task file, which is checked alongside QA_PASSED and recorded exit-code-0 evidence.
extracted_decision.summary: A reviewer technical APPROVED together with PO_REVIEW_PENDING status is sufficient to close the task; no separate manager approval word is required for this task.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Enables autonomous closure of an autopilot-locked task, at the cost of the manager reviewing the verdict only after the work is already committed; approval strength rests on a self-reported task-file line rather than a live manager message.

verbatim_quote.english_translation: Reviewer technical APPROVED + PO_REVIEW_PENDING counts as closure approval.
